scope: High-frequency inventory query result rows with low SOC value after local review
risk: May remove endpoint state needed for incident reconstruction or hunting
pre_enable_validation: Replay a representative window and prove marker/query counts, high-value query names, hostIdentifier, action, and columns survive; get SOC owner approval
rollback: Disable collector rule and replay original fixture/source sample

scope: Frequent severity 0/1 status rows that are not warnings/errors
risk: May hide osquery health, scheduler, and collection failures
pre_enable_validation: Compare status severity/message counts before and after filtering and prove warnings/errors remain searchable
rollback: Remove filter and restore full status forwarding

scope: Query-dependent columns such as command lines, paths, hashes, or listening addresses
risk: May remove fields required for triage, containment, and audit challenge
pre_enable_validation: Field-level sampling and Splunk read-back proving retained fields support declared detections/hunts
